title: Franz Schubert's birth chart
metaDescription: Franz Schubert's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 12.2° Aquarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.9° separates Venus and Uranus from an exact trine; at that range taste and disruption read as one mechanism. Trines are read as inheritance rather than achievement: the ease is genuine, and nothing about it was earned.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 12.2° Aquarius, inside the second decan (10°–20°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Mercury. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Venus was at 12.8° Capricorn, Mars was at 10.2° Aries. Read together: attraction that grows by reliability; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Venus and Uranus hold the closest angle here — a trine, 0.9° wide. Trines are read as inheritance rather than achievement: the ease is genuine, and nothing about it was earned. Behind it, Uranus sextile Neptune at 1.2°, and the Sun square Neptune at 1.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags three placements in this chart. The Sun in Aquarius at 12.2° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Aries at 10.2° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Pisces at 15.7° is in domicile. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 3 air, 3 water, 2 earth, 1 fire by element and 4 mutable, 3 fixed, 2 cardinal by mode. Mercury crossed from Aquarius into Pisces during that day, so its sign is left open. Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.4° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 19.8°.
